files.html: // examples/hello_world_owned_main/hello_world_owned_main.zig - hello_world with its own `main`. // // Draws examples/hello_world's text and squares (without its mouse circle and slider, to stay small). The // difference is who runs it: // // * hello_world is a DESCRIPTOR: it exports `pub const app: z.AppSpec(State)` and nothing else. zimr's runner // (src/wgpu_runner.zig) is the program's root - it owns `main`, the `z.App`, `std_options`, and each frame's // beginDrawing/endDrawing - and a launcher can tick the same descriptor into a part of its screen. // // * this one OWNS ITS MAIN. Registered with `.own_frame = true` in build.zig, the file itself is the program's // root, on the web and natively, so it declares what the runner would have: the `z.App`, `std_options` so logs // reach the page or standard error, and `main`, which hands init and update to `App.run` (which records the app // as the engine's `active_app`). It opens and closes each frame itself. No launcher can host it: there is no // descriptor to hand one, and a program has one root. // // Use this shape when an example needs to do something before or after the engine runs, or drive its frames by // hand (the 3D demos - cube_demo, lambert_demo - do the latter). Otherwise write a descriptor like hello_world. const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const z = @import("zimr"); const zm = @import("zm"); const Color = zm.Color; const float = zm.float; /// The program's root routes `std.log` - the runner's job for a descriptor, this file's here. pub const std_options: std.Options = z.std_options; /// The one app of the program: a global, so its address never changes. `App.run` records it as the engine's /// `active_app`, and the engine keeps pointers into it. Named `zimr_app`, the one module-level `var` zimrlint allows. pub var zimr_app: z.App = .{}; const State = struct { font: z.Font, }; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { const font: z.Font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 32); s.* = .{ .font = font }; } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { // The frame is ours to open and close: the runner does this for a descriptor. z.beginDrawing(f.gl); defer z.endDrawing(f.gl); z.clearViewport(f, .{ .r = 30, .g = 30, .b = 40, .a = 255 }); const sw: f32 = f.window.widthf(); const sh: f32 = f.window.heightf(); const cx: f32 = sw / 2; const cy: f32 = sh / 2; const white: Color = .{ .r = 240, .g = 240, .b = 240, .a = 255 }; const dim: Color = .{ .r = 140, .g = 140, .b = 150, .a = 255 }; const accent: Color = .{ .r = 96, .g = 165, .b = 250, .a = 255 }; // Concentric squares centred in the canvas, sized by its smaller side. const min_dim: f32 = @min(sw, sh); var i: i32 = 1; while (i <= 4) : (i += 1) { const half: f32 = min_dim * float(i) / 12.0; f.gl.rect( .{ .x = cx - half, .y = cy - half, .width = 2 * half, .height = 2 * half }, .{ .color = accent, .outline = 2 }, ); } f.gl.text(.{ cx - 90, cy - 18 }, "Hello, World!", .{ .size = 32, .color = white, .font = &s.font }); f.gl.textf( .{ cx - 110, cy + 30 }, "viewport: {d} x {d} CSS px", .{ sw, sh }, .{ .size = 14, .color = dim, .font = &s.font }, ); f.gl.text( .{ 16, sh - 24 }, "this example owns its main", .{ .size = 12, .color = dim, .font = &s.font }, ); } pub fn main() !void { try zimr_app.run(.{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - hello_world_owned_main", .width = 480, .height = 200, .scale_mode = .responsive, }, }, State, initState, update); // On the web `run` returns at once and the browser calls each frame through the `update` export. A native // program calls its frames itself, here, until its window closes. zimr_app.runNative(); }
